$comment: The frozen v0.1.11 baseline (YAZ-2073 1A/1B) every later YAZ-2073 change compares to. Built from 51e85cd (`npm run build` + `node tools/packDesktop.mjs --mac`) and measured on one machine: `npm run perf:budget` for size, `npm run perf -- <scenario> --runs N` for speed. One warm-up run is discarded; the rest are all listed, with the median, the nearest-rank p95 and cv (stdev / mean). N is 8 for launch and drawio, 3 for storm, heavy-tabs and quit-flush, 2 for idle, and 5 for the rest. The machine was shared with other agents while measuring (1-minute load 30–160; loadAvg is the load before → after each scenario), so absolute times are noisy. Compare a change against a fresh run of this app on the same machine, not against these numbers from another one.
